title: Air Hound Adventures (Hot Air Balloon Ride)
specs: Flights range from treetops up to 3000 feet
Flight path views include Orlando, Disney World, Lake Buena Vista, Celebration, Kissimmee, Four Corners, and Davenport
Balloon glow events light up the night sky with burner fire
Enchanted Romance Package includes private estate setting, professional photography, live harpist, and personal chef options
Each passenger must provide accurate weight; over 350 lb must contact before booking
Children should be 5 or 6 years old or older; parents decide
Pilots hold commercial balloon pilot license
Tether rides can carry 2 to 5 passengers at a time depending on weight

blurb: Guests experience hot air balloon flights averaging 45 to 60 minutes just after sunrise, weather permitting. They may also attend tethered balloon rides or balloon glow events where balloons are inflated and lit but do not fly. The company offers private romantic packages with tethered balloon experiences and luxury picnics on a private estate.
